subject: STABLE render-lead-opus: A3 GPU decode-shadow conversion (YCbCr+XR) + chain-capable CA/harness fakes; HEAVY RELEASE
body:
A3 LANDED (host-verified, not device-verified):
- Execute path calls tegu_shadow_refresh_jobs (compute_frontend.m, 1 line + decl). For a new/changed YCbCr ('420v' etc, all 24 formats 500-545) or XR (552-555, incl b3a8 plane) decode shadow, the CPU now only memcpys the source rows (1.5 B/px for 420) into a 2-slot per-device staging pool (targeted n2mb_wait_handles on the slot) and submits ONE n2mb_draw (legacy bindings: R8/R16/R32Uint luma, RG8/RG16/R32Uint chroma, R16Uint knot/half tables; push constants) into the shadow, before the command's jobs (GPU order). B2 wait list skips eligible shadows (the CPU never writes them). Refusal -> wait on the shadow handle + exact CPU decode. Kill switch TEGU_SHADOW_GPU=0 (all CPU) / =ycbcr (XR on CPU). New line TEGU_PERF_SURFACE gpu= cpu= cpu_fallback= gpu_us_per= cpu_us_per= max_us= (CPU us per surface).
- Shader route: authored GLSL (tests/shaders/nord2_{ycbcr,xr}_convert.frag) = exact integer model of ycbcr_decode.h / XR table lookups, compiled at build time by the pinned arch9 compiler via tools/generate_convert.c (appended to tools/generate_preload.sh -> build/tegu-frontend/nord2_convert.h, plan/push asserted). Same as the bridge preload shaders; no runtime compile, no translator.
- Evidence: tests/convert_shader_vk_test.py runs the SAME SPIR-V on the host Intel Vulkan GPU with the frontend's staging layout/push block: 243 YCbCr cases (24 formats x range x 601/709/2020, odd sizes, extremes) + 8 XR, 302371 texels, 0 mismatches vs the CPU decoder (bit-exact, not just half a 10-bit step); 2 shader mutations detected (30166 / 4540 mismatches). texture_format_frontend_test: new SHADOW_GPU ok=10 (staging bytes, n2r_validate of the rebuilt request, 1 submission, fallback exact, kill switch, p420 R32Uint, XR w40a). Mali binary itself NOT executed anywhere.
CHAIN FAKES: render harness prelude enables the shared fake's chain model when NORD2_METAL_CHAIN=1|2 and records per-frame last_chain; CA test inherits it. CA chain1/chain2 PASS with chaining active (per-draw kernel jobs 212->199, batched 21->19); harness chain1/chain2 PASS.
GATES (16:35-17:05, tree also had encode-cpu's concurrent hunks): run_host_tests (AIR_LLVM_BIN=/usr/bin, SCOPE=compilers) all passed incl ARM64 frontend + strict link; texture_format PASS; CA PF0/PF1 PASS; CA CHAIN1/CHAIN2 PASS; render harness PASS (chain off/1/2); async_frontend 7/7; integration --candidate = known CA 66/42 only.
